summary: Fire camp in 1916, cupola cabin in 1921, L-4 cab in 1936; the cab was removed or destroyed in 1968 and no standing structure is described.

facts.design: Cupola cabin (1921), replaced in 1936 by an L-4 cab

notes_for_editor: Brief status gone and the 2012 FFLOS registration (October 21, 2012) are confirmed. Brief access unknown is set to public from the Willhiteweb trail note; no source gives an official access status. The removed-versus-destroyed conflict for 1968 is unresolved and reported as a conflict. Source 3 reads Removed as a status label. Staffing is one name (1933). No source describes remains on the site.
